description: A signed audit record (docs/audit.md): one per /v1/evaluate call, chained per app through prev_hash. Body of GET /v1/audit/:id.

conversation_id_hash.description: sha256(app_salt + conversation_id). Raw conversation ids are never stored.
conversation_id_hash.title: Sha256Hash

anyOf.description: A SHA-256 digest written as sha256:<64 lowercase hex digits>.
anyOf.title: Sha256Hash

user_hash.description: The app-supplied user hash normalised to sha256:<hex>, or null when the request carried none.

surface.description: Where the slot would have rendered: the request surface without max_creatives.
surface.title: AuditSurface

classification.description: What the classifier concluded about the conversation turn. Never contains message text.

commercial_intent.description: 0..1 likelihood the user is in a buying context.

categories.description: Commercial categories detected, most relevant first.

items.description: A commercial content category. Matches fixtures/classify-fixtures.json.
items.title: ContentCategory

sensitive.description: Sensitive topics detected. Any entry blocks ads under strict detection.

items.description: A sensitive topic that blocks ads. Matches fixtures/classify-fixtures.json.
items.title: SensitiveCategory

method.description: llm when the LLM classifier answered in time, rules when only the rule stage ran, cached when a recent classification of the same text was reused.
method.title: ClassificationMethod

prompt_version.description: Version of the classifier prompt or rule set, e.g. sha256:<hex>.

classification.title: Classification

policy_version.description: The version field of the policy applied.

policy_decisions.description: One entry per rule in docs/policy.md rule order, pass or fail.

items.description: One entry of an audit record policy_decisions list: the outcome of one rule. Every rule records an entry, pass or fail.

rule.description: A docs/policy.md rule name, listed in the order the rules run.
rule.title: PolicyRule

result.description: pass or fail for rules resolved by the policy engine; pending for competitor_exclusions, which is resolved during creative selection.
result.title: PolicyDecisionResult

detail.description: Human-readable context, e.g. session=0/1 day=1/3 turns_since=9. Never contains message text.

items.title: PolicyDecision

override_rejected.description: policy_overrides values that would have loosened the policy and were ignored (docs/policy.md Overrides). Empty when none.

items.description: A policy_overrides value that would have loosened the stored policy and was ignored.

path.description: Dotted path of the ignored override, e.g. frequency_caps.per_session or demand[1].

items.title: OverrideRejection

anyOf.description: Why no ad was served: paid_user, region_blocked, sensitive_category:<name> (name from the sensitive taxonomy), low_confidence, low_commercial_intent, frequency_cap, no_fill, or error.
anyOf.title: SuppressReason

demand.description: The demand block of an audit record: the mediation trace for one evaluation (docs/audit.md).

requested.description: The sources queried, in policy demand order (enabled entries only).

items.description: Demand source that supplied a creative (see docs/policy.md demand list).
items.title: DemandSource

responses.description: One entry per requested source, in the same order.

items.description: One entry of an audit record demand.responses list: a demand adapter answer with the candidates reduced to a count. error is set when the adapter failed, timed out or was aborted.

source.description: Demand source that supplied a creative (see docs/policy.md demand list).
source.title: DemandSource

candidates.description: How many candidates the source returned (0 on failure or timeout).

error.description: Set when the adapter failed, timed out or was aborted. Never message text.

items.title: DemandResponseSummary

excluded.description: Candidates dropped by competitor_exclusions, in the order they were seen.

items.description: One entry of an audit record demand.excluded list: a candidate mediation dropped before ranking. This resolves the pending competitor_exclusions policy decision.

source.description: Demand source that supplied a creative (see docs/policy.md demand list).
source.title: DemandSource

advertiser_domain.description: The candidate advertiser domain that matched a competitor exclusion.
advertiser_domain.title: AdvertiserDomain

reason.description: Why the candidate was dropped. Only competitor_exclusion exists in v1.

items.title: ExcludedCandidate

anyOf.description: Demand source that supplied a creative (see docs/policy.md demand list).
anyOf.title: DemandSource

selected.description: The source of the winning candidate, or null when nothing was selected (no_fill).

demand.title: DemandTrace

anyOf.description: The served creative as recorded: identity plus a content hash, never the copy.

content_hash.description: sha256 over the canonical JSON of the creative content (advertiser, advertiser_domain, headline, body, cta, url_template). Verification compares it with the stored creative.
content_hash.title: Sha256Hash

anyOf.title: AuditCreative

disclosure.description: The disclosure the policy required for this turn. No defaults: signed as written.

label.description: Label rendered on the sponsored block. Must be non-empty.
label.title: DisclosureLabel

disclosure.title: AuditDisclosure

anyOf.description: A SHA-256 digest written as sha256:<64 lowercase hex digits>.
anyOf.title: Sha256Hash

model_output_hash.description: Set by attestation: the hash of the model output the SDK rendered the slot after.

separation_attestation.description: true only on a record produced by attestation (POST /v1/attest).

anyOf.description: A SHA-256 digest written as sha256:<64 lowercase hex digits>.
anyOf.title: Sha256Hash

supersedes_hash.description: On an attestation record: the record_hash of the record it supersedes. Both stay in the chain.

anyOf.description: A SHA-256 digest written as sha256:<64 lowercase hex digits>.
anyOf.title: Sha256Hash

prev_hash.description: The record_hash of the previous record for the same app_id, or the literal genesis for the first record.
prev_hash.title: PrevHash

record_hash.description: sha256 over the canonical JSON of the record without record_hash and signature, concatenated with prev_hash.
record_hash.title: Sha256Hash

signature.description: Ed25519 over the record_hash string, by key_id.
signature.title: Ed25519Signature

key_id.description: Identifier of the Ed25519 key pair that signed a record, e.g. k_2026_09.
key_id.title: KeyId

title: AuditRecord
